reason: With 1,350 members and a commercially run course I can't hang tee times, invoicing and the bar tab on two founders whose first club isn't even live yet. The free pilot is generous, but it's still a project for me and my staff, and I'm already drowning in evenings of admin.
objection: Nothing in the offer says it works with the NGF handicap system or our direct debit collection. If members have to look up handicaps somewhere else or we invoice twice, it's more work for me, not less. And if two people get ill or quit, my whole club is stuck.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle live for a season with their board telling me it's running smoothly, plus written confirmation that it links to the NGF handicap system and our SEPA direct debit, in time to put it on the spring members' meeting budget.
